narration:0:1460128001:1.text: With a reluctant sigh, you set off once again, the lessons learned and ideas gathered in tow, heading back to the Ashen Wastes.
narration:0:1460128001:1.source_cn: 你们再次启程，带着一路上的灵感与收获，返回了荒角沙漠！

say:2:1460128002:0.text: Just as you're about to reach the Sunseek Arena, two voices you recognize ring out, stopping you in your tracks.
say:2:1460128002:0.source_cn: 只是，刚来到残阳武斗场附近，就听到了熟悉的声音……

say:5:1460128003:0.text: I don't care for this sort of contest. Fighting for an audience feels like I'm putting on a show...
say:5:1460128003:0.source_cn: 我对这种比赛没什么兴趣，而且在一群人面前战斗，像表演一样……

say:6:1460128004:0.text: Don't think too much of it, just treat it as a regular spar!
say:6:1460128004:0.source_cn: 就当做表演嘛，拜托了，不动手也可以，当作近距离欣赏我的...

choice_prompt:7:1460128005.text: Oh, you all just came in time! No matter what I say, Antandra just doesn't want to participate.
choice_prompt:7:1460128005.source_cn: 啊，你们来得正好，不管我怎么说，安丹德拉就是不想参加比赛！

say:8:1460128005:0.text: Oh, you all just came in time! No matter what I say, Antandra just doesn't want to participate.
say:8:1460128005:0.source_cn: 啊，你们来得正好，不管我怎么说，安丹德拉就是不想参加比赛！

say:9:1460128006:0.text: She's so skilled, and a perfect partner for me yet...
say:9:1460128006:0.source_cn: 明明身手那么好，而且和我搭档又特别合适……

choice_prompt:10:1460128007.text: Of course! Who doesn't like a blood-boiling battle? That's why I told Antandra to come.
choice_prompt:10:1460128007.source_cn: 当然啦！我也喜欢亲身体验热血沸腾的战斗，所以才约了安丹德拉。
choice_prompt:10:1460128007.male: Of course! Who doesn't like a blood-boiling battle? That's why I told Antandra to come.
choice_prompt:10:1460128007.female: Of course! Who doesn't like a blood-boiling battle? That's why I told Antandra to come.

say:11:1460128007:0.text: Of course! Who doesn't like a blood-boiling battle? That's why I told Antandra to come.

say:11:1460128007:0.female: Of course! Who doesn't like a blood-boiling battle? That's why I told Antandra to come.

say:12:1460128010:0.text: Oh, why don't we spar right now and have Master Pang check out our moves?
say:12:1460128010:0.source_cn: 对了，我们不如现场比一下，就让这位潘先生点评！

say:13:1460128011:0.text: If we don't work well on a team, I won't force you, alright? Come on, please?
say:13:1460128011:0.source_cn: 如果我们配合不合适，我就不强迫你了，好不好嘛。

say:15:1460128013:0.text: Alright, sorry to trouble you all.

say:17:1460128008:0.text: I told Mikola already that when I'm not competing, I'll commentate with her, but I'm still competing.
say:17:1460128008:0.source_cn: 我跟曼卡拉说好了，不参赛的时候就解说，上场的时候就比赛！
say:17:1460128008:0.male: I told Mikola already that when I'm not competing, I'll commentate with her, but I'm still competing.
say:17:1460128008:0.female: I told Mikola already that when I'm not competing, I'll commentate with her, but I'm still competing.

say:18:1460128009:0.text: However, Antandra refuses to team up with me.
say:18:1460128009:0.source_cn: 结果安丹德拉怎么也不答应和我组队。
